lines.text: Many learners say: I spent two hours to do my homework.
Better: I spent two hours doing my homework.
Studying! I spent an hour studying English.

data.wrong: I spent two hours to do my homework.
data.right: I spent two hours doing my homework.

native.tip: 中文说“花两小时做作业”，容易照搬成 to do。英语 spend 时间后面要接动词的 -ing 形式。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I spent two hours to do my homework.”😅 spend 时间后面要接 -ing，不能用 to do：“I spent two hours doing my homework.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I spent two hours doing my homework.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: After spend and a time, use the -ing form.
en.caption: Do you say “I spent two hours to do my homework.” 😅 After spend and a time, use the -ing form: “I spent two hours doing my homework.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
